question: Should CodexBar adopt this permanent local usage-card export surface, and should it share one subscription aggregation model with the companion dashboard if both features proceed?
rationale: VISION.md reserves new product and privacy-affecting surfaces for sign-off, while the two open drafts otherwise introduce separate long-lived aggregation implementations.

options.title: Sponsor and unify
options.body: Approve the local export concept and require a shared aggregation seam before both this PR and the companion dashboard land.

options.title: Sponsor export only
options.body: Approve this local sharing workflow while declining or deferring the companion dashboard to avoid parallel models.

options.title: Decline the surface
options.body: Keep CodexBar focused on in-app and CLI usage visibility without a dedicated sharing workflow.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and unify
recommendation.body: Approve the local export concept and require a shared aggregation seam before both this PR and the companion dashboard land.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner defines the VISION.md sign-off boundary and is the strongest available owner for permanent product-surface decisions.
